    Homogeneous lifts of morphisms at t = 1 (Proposition 12.8, morphisms) #

    deformation-refinements.tex: "after lifting a homogeneous map of degree r ≥ 0 through correction degrees less than q, its next linearity defect is a one-cocycle of degree r + q. The positive Ext¹ vanishing removes it with the chosen right inverse."

    At the fibre t = 1 a morphism φ of C of degree r and weight ρ lifts to a morphism of the lifted modules of order r, with leading term φ, all of whose components have relative weights in the cone, and whose component of relative weight 0 is φ itself (exists_liftHom).
